name: Decode CAD3
description: Decode a complete hexadecimal CAD3 encoding into its native Convex data structure. Accepts both single-cell and self-contained multi-cell encodings.

encoding.description: Complete CAD3 bytes as hexadecimal, with or without the 0x prefix

output.description: The decoded native Convex value. JSON transports may render non-JSON CAD3 types as their Convex string form.
